applicant.name: Dr. Katharina Wimmer
applicant.organisation: Department of Pulmonology, Medical University of Graz (university hospital)

purpose: We are validating a prognostic score for COPD exacerbations that uses weight change over time. This requires each patient's BMI history alongside their diagnoses and inhaler therapy, which cannot be reconstructed from aggregated tables.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and BMI values for adults with COPD who have at least one BMI value.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Cohort = adults with COPD who have at least one BMI value (LOINC 39156-5).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). The applicant has shown that anonymised data cannot achieve it, so pseudonymised data is justified (Art. 66(3)). Access only under a data permit (Art. 68) inside a secure processing environment; only non-personal data may leave it (Art. 73(2)).

judge.why: Rule 4: the application validates a prognostic score using each patient's BMI history over time alongside diagnoses and inhaler therapy, which statistics cannot do, and the Report line is a cohort size, not a per-group statistic.
